title: Veikalā (At the shop)
summary: Two shoppers at Rimi help each other find items, compare prices, and check out together.

roles.name: Pircējs A
roles.label: Shopper A
roles.objective: Ask for help finding bread, milk, and fruit. Suggest splitting the queue.
starter_lines: Sveiki, vai jūs zināt, kur ir maize?
Es meklēju arī pienu un āboļus.
Iesim divās rindās, lai būtu ātrāk.

roles.name: Pircējs B
roles.label: Shopper B
roles.objective: Help locate items, compare prices, and offer to share a shopping basket.
starter_lines: Sveiki! Maize ir tur, otrajā plauktā.
Piens ir aukstā vitrīnā pie sienas.
Vai jūs vēlaties dalīties ar grozu?

objectives_shared: Help find at least two products.
Wish each other a nice day at checkout.
safety_rules: No personal contact info, no loyalty-card numbers.
